name: Rafael
source:
One of the "Usagi Tenshi" working under the goddess. The youngest member. Cheerful and bright.

She likes moving and fish. She is an idiot who is honest with everyone. Recently, she's only been interested in Rosario.

"I can't lose to you."

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official website[/url]]
